name: Mercedes BR Jaya Half Marathon & Duathlon
short_description: A half marathon and duathlon event held on November 15, 2026 at AEON Mall Kulai Jaya, Johor, Malaysia, with 21.1km, 10km, and 5km distance options.
ai_summary: The Mercedes BR Jaya Half Marathon & Duathlon is scheduled for November 15, 2026, at AEON Mall Kulai Jaya in Johor, Malaysia. It offers three distance options: 21.1km, 10km, and 5km, catering to a range of runners from beginners to more experienced participants. Registration for the event is currently open. The race takes place in the city of Kulai, Malaysia.
